Perusal of the above extract reveals that the order is sufficiently reasoned and has duly considered the reply filed by the Petitioner.

However, considering the fact that the impugned order has been uploaded on the ‘Additional Notices Tab’ and that challenge to the validity of the impugned notifications is pending before the Supreme Court, as also this Court, the Petitioner is allowed to file an appeal by 15th July, 2025.

However, it is made clear that the issue in respect of the validity of the impugned notifications is left open and the order of the Appellate Authority shall be subject to the outcome of the decision of (i) the Supreme Court in S.L.P No 4240/2025 titled ‘M/s HCC- SEW-MEIL-AAG JV v. Assistant Commissioner of State Tax & Ors’ and (ii) this Court in W.P.(C) 9214/2024 titled ‘Engineers India Limited v. Union of India & Ors’

outcome.quote: Accordingly, the present writ petition is disposed of.
